text: oh wow it really is just literally flat planes. well kinda how come some of them are front and back faced planes while others just have the front with a face and empty backm uh like the flora_pine is no 'back face' erm actually i guess there is more that dont have a backface than those that do. like uh blade grass is double sided and so is the palm tree fronds but then pine and others are all one sided planes
resolution: Question about why some flora meshes are double-sided and others single-sided. Answered from the render code: flora draws through two GPU pipelines — the grass pipeline (blades/bushes/flowers) back-face culls, so those meshes physically carry both windings; the frond pipeline (palm fronds + all nine wrapped species) has cull_mode=.none, so a single quad reads from both sides for free and the wrapped species deliberately never duplicate back triangles to spend their fixed 512-vertex budget on plant instead of redundant backs (flora_geometry.zig header states this). The palm frond is double-sided only because it is the older authoring generation. The studio mesh viewer back-face culls like the standard pipeline, which is why single-sided cards look hollow from behind there while never showing a hole in game. No code changed.
